title: Filled power table state
statement: A state satisfies the filled power-table condition for an initial memory $[?25lμ$, destination $dst$, length $L$, base $b$, list $t$, and index $j$ if there is a memory $[?25lμ'$ such that its location map is the frame formed from $dst,L,b,j,b^j,t$, its memory map is $[?25lμ'$, every cell $dst+i$ for $i<j$ contains $b^i$, and $[?25lμ'$ agrees with $[?25lμ$ outside the destination region of length $L$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the frame construction or the exact meaning of agreement outside the destination region.
